sourceChecks.text: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.
sourceChecks.previousContext: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
sourceChecks.nextContext: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.
